components.name: Primary continuation button
components.description: The sole filled continuation action in the top command bar.
components.css: .ds-primary{height:42px;padding:0 17px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#ff4f17;color:#fff;font:650 13px/1 Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out}.ds-primary:hover{background:#e94712}.ds-primary:disabled{background:rgba(37,37,33,.08);color:rgba(37,37,33,.42);cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff4f17;outline-offset:2px}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}

components.css: .ds-search{position:relative;display:block;width:270px;height:40px;color:#fff}.ds-search input{width:100%;height:40px;padding:0 44px 0 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:22px;outline:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font:14px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}.ds-search input:focus{background:rgba(18,24,28,.96)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-search svg{position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;width:19px;height:19px;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Map terrain switch
components.description: A compact segmented chooser for synchronized map and terrain views.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.ds-switch button{min-width:58px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);font:600 13px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch button:hover{color:#fff}.ds-switch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-switch .ds-active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}

components.name: Plan / Analyze stage switch
components.description: The 48px centered state instrument; Route Ember is reserved for the active global trip state.
components.css: .ds-stage{display:flex;gap:3px;height:48px;padding:3px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#171c1f;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}.ds-stage button{min-width:76px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font:650 14px/1 Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-stage .is-active{background:#ff4f17;color:#fff}.ds-stage button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff4f17;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Map tool rail
components.description: High-frequency planning navigation: a narrow #171c1f desktop instrument that reflows into mobile controls.
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail" aria-label="行程工具"><button class="ds-logo">T3</button><button class="ds-active">规划</button><button>线路库</button><button>天气</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail{display:grid;gap:2px;width:48px;padding:4px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#171c1f;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2);color:#fff}.ds-rail button{position:relative;width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font:600 10px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out}.ds-rail button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}.ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff4f17;outline-offset:2px}.ds-rail .ds-active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#ff4f17}.ds-rail .ds-active:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-5px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:#ff4f17}.ds-rail button:active{transform:scale(.97)}

components.name: Planner context hint

components.css: .ds-journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(150px,230px) minmax(0,1fr) auto;min-height:62px;overflow:hidden;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(23,28,31,.96);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font-family:Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(108%)}.ds-journey.has-route{min-height:78px}.ds-journey header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 14px}.ds-journey header b{font-size:14px}.ds-journey header span{padding-left:10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:58px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-row span b,.ds-row span small{display:block}.ds-row span b{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:12px}.ds-row span small,.ds-row em{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:10px;font-style:normal}.ds-row strong{font-size:11px}.ds-row.ds-selected{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);box-shadow:inset 1px 0 #ff4f17}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff4f17;outline-offset:-2px}

components.css: .ds-weather{width:248px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(250,250,247,.9);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,10,12,.22);color:#1f2428;font-family:Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(112%);transition:opacity 130ms ease-out,transform 130ms ease-out}.ds-weather header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather header b,.ds-weather header span{display:block}.ds-weather header b{font-size:14px}.ds-weather header span,dt,footer span{margin-top:2px;color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:10px}.ds-weather header button,.ds-weather footer button{border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-weather header button{width:30px;height:30px;color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:18px}.ds-temp{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;padding:12px}.ds-temp strong{font-size:25px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-temp span{color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:12px}.ds-weather dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin:0 12px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14);border-radius:10px}.ds-weather dl div{padding:8px 9px}.ds-weather dl div+div{border-left:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather dt{margin:0}.ds-weather dd{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-weather footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:42px;padding:0 12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather footer button{height:32px;color:#2f80a8;font:600 11px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-weather button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
TRIP 3D is a Chinese-first terrain instrument, not a dashboard beside a map. Neutral limestone-gray hillshade and contour texture hold the visual field, while #171c1f-class instruments establish a quiet operating hierarchy. Route Ember stays rare: it traces the route, identifies the active Plan/Analyze state, and marks direct selection.

Desktop fixes brand/search and Plan/Analyze, keeps destinations in the left rail, and unifies expandable Save/Share, Layers, Zoom, and Fit in one right dock. The shared Inspector, Route Summary/Elevation Profile, and marker Weather card use one session layout system with pointer manipulation and measured safe areas. Below 1024px, free layout yields to the existing bottom sheet and touch-first map controls.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral limestone-gray terrain with a sharp orange route signal.
8/10/12/14px geometry with restrained shadows and no double shells.
One shared desktop floating-instrument system with measured safe areas.
Below-1024 reflow that disables free layout and protects map gestures.

rules.name: The One Route Voice Rule
rules.body: Route orange is reserved for the active route, direct selection, the global Plan/Analyze state, and an enabled primary action; secondary route and date choices are dark selected states.

rules.name: The Fixed-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Brand and stage stay fixed; the left rail owns destinations and one right dock owns global and map actions.

rules.name: The Fluid Instrument Rule
rules.body: Inspector, Route Summary/Elevation Profile, and marker Weather share drag, resize, collision, reset, and measured safe-area behavior on desktop only.

rules.name: The Operational Type Rule
rules.body: Use weight, size, and short labels to establish priority; do not add a second display voice or force dense route data into oversized type.

rules.name: The Continuous Map Rule
rules.body: Chrome attaches to the map edge or collapses into the shared sheet; no open state may fragment the trip into competing dashboard columns.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Use elevation only to establish a floating map context; do not add shadows to ordinary content rows or invent a card hierarchy.

rules.name: The Contextual Frost Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs exclusively to map-anchored information and dark/light map controls, with opaque fallbacks when reduced transparency is requested.

rules.name: The Grouped Row Rule
rules.body: Reserve rounded outer corners for a meaningful group; internal rows divide with fine lines and selection rules instead of acquiring individual card silhouettes.

dos: Do keep neutral terrain and the route as the visual proof of the product.
Do use Route Ember only for movement, explicit selection, the active Plan/Analyze state, and enabled primary actions.
Do keep fixed chrome separate from movable contextual instruments.
Do preserve warm-panel inspector context and dark profile continuity.
Do disable free layout below 1024px and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't turn contextual route detail into a card grid.
Don't use pervasive glass, glow, or gradient identity.
Don't use broad transitions, bounce, or hover lift.
Don't hide unavailable terrain, weather, or saved state behind polished treatment.
